annotation.title_clean: Executive Order on Maintaining American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: Executive Order on Maintaining American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: The White House (President Donald J. Trump)
annotation.summary_en: US Executive Order 13859 (Feb 2019) launching the American AI Initiative. It directs agencies to prioritise AI R&D investment, improve access to federal data and computing resources, develop technical standards, train the AI workforce, and promote international engagement while protecting US advantages. It is innovation-focused and has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the American AI Initiative with five principles: R&D, data and compute access, standards, workforce, international engagement
Directs agencies to prioritise AI R&D investment
Requires agencies to improve access to federal data, models and computing resources, with privacy and security safeguards
Tasks NIST with developing a plan for federal engagement in AI technical standards
Promotes AI education and workforce training and a favourable international environment
